name: lsp-vue
description: Vue support through @vue/language-server 2.2.12 in standalone mode. Install the server and workspace TypeScript, then enable this plugin.

command.description: The Vue 2.2.12 language server command or absolute path on the workspace machine

tsdkPath.description: The TypeScript lib folder on the workspace machine; empty finds workspace TypeScript

args: const fs=require("node:fs"),path=require("node:path");const p=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(0,"utf8"));const settings=p.settings||{};let tsdk=settings.tsdkPath;try{tsdk=tsdk?path.resolve(p.root,tsdk):path.dirname(require.resolve("typescript",{paths:[p.root]}));}catch(e){console.error("Vue needs TypeScript in this workspace: npm install -D typescript, or set plugins.lsp-vue.tsdkPath to its lib folder.");process.exit(1);}process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify({command:settings.command||"vue-language-server",args:["--stdio"],initializationOptions:{typescript:{tsdk},vue:{hybridMode:false}}}));
